title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 19: the cities for the man slayer, the landmark, and the law about false witnesses.

questions.text: How many cities were the Israelites first told to set apart in the middle of their land?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says they were to set apart three cities in the middle of the land Yahweh gave them.

questions.text: Who was allowed to flee to one of these cities and live?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 speaks of whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally and did not hate him in time past.

answers.text: Anyone who had killed a man in anger
Someone who killed his neighbor unintentionally
A thief who was caught at night
A witness who had testified falsely

questions.text: What example of an accident does verse 5 give?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 describes a man chopping wood whose ax head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies.

answers.text: A stone falling from the roof of a new house
An ox goring a man while plowing the field
An ax head slipping from its handle while chopping wood
An arrow shot by mistake during a hunt

questions.text: Who might pursue the man slayer while hot anger was in his heart?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 warns that the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart.

questions.text: According to verse 6, why might the avenger overtake the man slayer?
questions.explanation: The avenger might overtake him "because the way is long."

answers.text: Because the man slayer was old
Because the city gates were shut

questions.text: What were the Israelites to do if Yahweh enlarged their border and they kept his commandment?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says that then they were to add three cities more, in addition to these three.

questions.text: What happened when a man who hated his neighbor and killed him fled to one of these cities?
questions.explanation: The elders of his city were to send and bring him back and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

answers.text: He was allowed to stay there for the rest of his life
He paid a fine to the family and went free
He was sold as a slave to a foreigner
His elders handed him over to the avenger of blood

questions.text: What does verse 14 forbid the Israelites to remove?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says: "You shall not remove your neighbor's landmark, which they of old time have set."

questions.text: What was to be done to a witness who had testified falsely against his brother?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says: "you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother."

answers.text: Let him go home with only a warning
Make him serve the priests for a full year
Send him away to one of the cities of refuge
Do to him what he had thought to do to his brother

questions.text: Which phrase belongs in verse 21: "life for life, eye for eye, ... "?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 says: "life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot."
